entries.title: Z1
entries.text: Labored with Zyopa mostly at home You were worried what a hospital setting would do to your mental health and your delivery, and so you did everything possible to delay going to the hospital and it worked! Nice job!

entries.title: Z2
entries.text: Birthed Zyopik without epidural You wanted to ensure minimum complications resulting resulting from interventions... and you did it!

entries.title: Z3
entries.text: Fed Zephrine enough to make her just the cutest ball of blubber that exists on the planet She was bottom 10 percentile, and now she's 80th. That's very measurable achievement right there!

entries.title: Z9
entries.text: You've ensured Zephrine has the best (but not excessive amounts of) toys I've seen other parents' houses. They look like toy apocalypses. You believe that a few amazing toys are better than a whole bunch of cheap, okay toys, and you've curated her toys so that she only has ones that bring her lots of joy

entries.title: Z5
entries.text: Spent hours getting Zyopa to sleep Your goal was to always keep Zyopik mentally healthy. Her brain seems to be working great. Mission accomplished!

entries.title: Z10
entries.text: You got Zyopa to sleep in her crib This was especially hard for you because you don't ever want to be apart from her. But you value her development and our sleep too, so you were able to make the hard decision. Nice going!

entries.title: Z4
entries.text: You got Zyopik mobile by taking her to PT As of my writing this, Zyopik is almost crawling! That's all you!

entries.title: Z11
entries.text: You got someone to teach you how to wear Zephrine You believe in leveraging all resources available to you, and this is an example of when you did that. Nice job!

entries.title: Z12
entries.text: You introduced the lady to solid foods! As a foodie, your goal was to make sure that Zephrine is not a picky eater. You want to make sure she is able to enjoy all kinds of foods, so as soon as it was safe to do so, you introduced a variety of foods. It's going very well!

entries.title: Z13
entries.text: Spent many consecutive hours feeding Zephrine daily to ensure she only gets the highest quality food! You never wanted Zephrine to have processed formula, and with only a few exceptions, you did it!

entries.title: Z14
entries.text: You ensured Zephrine would know her cousins Planning with out-of-town family when taking care of a baby isn't easy, but you did it because you want Noa and Lilou to get to know Zephrine. They got along amazingly. Great job!

entries.title: Z15
entries.text: You maintain(ed) Zyopik's WhatsApp Group You very much value community, and know how important it will be for Zyopa to have people around her that know her and care about her. You take the time to keep everyone in our community engaged through WhatsApp as a result. It takes a lot of your time, energy, and brainpower.

entries.title: Z6
entries.text: You made Zyopa's room while pregnant What you did would be hard while NOT pregnant. You believe in design and good vibes in all spaces, especially for you newborn daughter, and you did beautifully.

entries.title: Z16
entries.text: You managed your Fetus Diabeetus Food, control, AND major consequences if you don't comply? That's like gunpowder and flame for you. But in this case, no explosion happened. It was difficult, but you managed it gracefully. And Zyopik is healthy and diabeetus-free as a result. That's an amazing accomplishment.

entries.title: Z7
entries.text: You ensured that Zyopa had the best pediatrician! We could have gone with a mediocre pediatrician that we felt uneasy about. But no, you kept searching for a good pediatrician until you made sure Zyopik was in good hands.

entries.title: Z17
entries.text: You got a nursing coach You believe in leveraging all resources available to you, and this is an example of when you did that. Nice job!

entries.title: Z18
entries.text: Engaged in groups of mom-friends to exchange tips with Your goal was always to have community supporting each other with whatever you happen to be doing. Goal succeeded!

entries.title: Z8
entries.text: You maintain(ed) Zyopik's wardrobe so that she always looks her best (and chemical-freest) I'm not going to pretend that I value being chemical-free as much as you do, but YOU value it, and you always make sure that Zyopik gets the best feeling and best looking clothing. You also use Zyopa’s wardrobe to make sure that everyone knows that Zyopik is number one, because you want Zyopik to have an engaged community of people.

entries.title: O1
entries.text: Cooked one of the best chowders I've ever had. Shame on you Chicago restaurants! You wanted to cook more at home, and not sacrifice on deliciousness. Mission accomplished!

entries.title: O2
entries.text: Cooked one of the best potato stews I've ever had. Shame on you Chicago restaurants! You wanted to cook more at home, and not sacrifice on deliciousness. Mission accomplished!

entries.title: O3
entries.text: Encouraged me to run every day You want me to be healthy and live a long time! Exercising regularly is statistically one of the most important things that contributes to that.

entries.title: O4
entries.text: Always encouraged me to listen to my body when it comes to eating... which has enabled me to lose weight healthily! You don't me to develop an eating disorder. You've had enough of that in your surroundings to last you a lifetime. Congratulations on being a wall that eating disorders can't get past!

entries.title: O5
entries.text: Donating lots of stuff to Prenatal Fit You value generosity and community. 2 birds, 1 Stone. Nice job!

entries.title: O16
entries.text: You made the best salads You have goals to save money, eat healthy, and eat delicious. The salads you make accomplish all of that. I typically hate salads made at home, but yours taste really refreshing. Nice job!

entries.title: O6
entries.text: Donating things to a person less fortunate than you You value generosity and community. 2 birds, 1 Stone. Nice job!

entries.title: O8
entries.text: You got an office with a tree You love nature and being able to incorporate it into your everyday! Treehouse at home and now treehouse at work!

entries.title: O9
entries.text: You walk to your office with the family! You've always wanted a situation where you get to walk with your family to the office and have delicious food places nearby. Mission complete.

entries.title: O7
entries.text: You moved offices… while having a baby who’s 100% dependent on you You HATE HATE HATE when people act shitty and inconsiderately, so when people did that non-chalantly to you, you calmly did something about it, despite how hard it was with a baby.

entries.title: O10
entries.text: Lana had her second child with NSAGO and loved it! You always want to use your experience to improve other peoples'. This was a very clear example of that. You did it!

entries.title: O11
entries.text: You introduced Zoe to hotpot Good food is something you value and you really want other people and understand. You accomplished that by showing Zoe a whole new food type she's never experienced

entries.title: O12
entries.text: You encouraged my sushi-making habit We've rarely eaten sushi out this past year. But we've still had some awesome sushi meals! Without your encouragement, I don't think I'd be as good at this as I am now. Also, huge money-saver. Nice job!

entries.title: O13
entries.text: You started going to the Farmer's Market regularly Having fresh, local, delicious food, is something you've always valued, and you found a way to accomplish it. Nice job!

entries.title: O14
entries.text: You did things to maintain yourself every day. Getting up everyday when you feel like ass and going to a massage or reflexology may seem like fun to other people, but I know how hard it is to just get out of bed for you some days. Especially when you've spent an entire night feeding our little spherical munchin. But you value growth and feeling good, and you don't let yourself get beaten down, even when you're not sure how you can keep going. That takes bravery and determination, the kind that I can only dream of having.

entries.title: O15
entries.text: You reorganized and decluttered to improve your functioning I can't tell you about how many threads I read in the ADHD_partners subbreddit that talk about how their partners are too oblivious to manage their own ADHD, even when they're aware of it. You are continuously optimizing your environment because you have big goals, damn it, and you don't want to let anything stand in your way!

entries.title: O19
entries.text: You did a great job hosting your parents! It wasn't easy for you after what happened during the pregnancy, but you believe in togetherness and community, so you found a way, and it was a good experience!

entries.title: O17
entries.text: You retained your patients after maternity leave People could leave when someone goes on maternity leave. My therapist certainly excepts some of her patients to. The fact that yours stayed speaks to your quality as a therapist.

entries.title: O18
entries.text: You got off your parents' mobile phone plan Your goal was to be fully indepndent. Now that you're off your parents' phone plan, your independence has been achieved!

entries.title: O20
entries.text: Went to the stroller bootcamp classes even though you felt like crap You believe in physical fitness, so the first chance you had to go to the stroller classes, you took it. And you didn't slack off either. You pushed ME into working harder, even. Now, I know what you're going to say "yeah, yeah, yeah, but but I stopped going." Yeah, you listened to your body, and when you were sleep-deprived and beaten up as fuck, you stopped. But guess what? The class is once a week, and your morning stretch routine is EVERY DAY. Consistency is the more important thing. Maybe I should stop debating a hypothetical "you" now? Maybe.

entries.title: O21
entries.text: You engaged in financial therapy Controlling spending isn't easy for you. Despite that, you fully engaged with financial therapy and really worked hard to ensure that we can both be less panicked about our financial situation! That was definitely your goal, and you succeeded!
